title: ENG-205 Sir Gawain Part 2 — 4 Main Ideas
subject: ENG-205

cards.def: Because Gawain must take the Green Knight's return blow nearby on New Year's Day, he rests at Bertilak's castle while Bertilak hunts, and each evening they trade their winnings.

cards.term: 2. Day one: the deer and one kiss
cards.def: While Bertilak hunts deer, Lady Bertilak sneaks into Gawain's bedroom to tempt him, but Gawain politely accepts only one kiss, which he gives Bertilak that night for the deer.

cards.term: 3. Day two: the boar and two kisses
cards.def: While Bertilak hunts a fierce boar, Lady Bertilak returns and begs Gawain to teach her about love, but Gawain politely refuses, so that night he trades two kisses for the boar.
While Bertilak chases a fox, Lady Bertilak offers Gawain a green silk girdle she says will keep him from being killed, and Gawain, fearing the axe, accepts it and promises secrecy.
That night Bertilak hands over the fox and Gawain gives him three kisses but keeps the girdle secret, so Gawain breaks his promise to trade everything he gained.
